Name: Eshek
Summary: Brother of Azel, father of Ulam, Jehush, and Eliphelet.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:39: Brother of Azel, father of Ulam, Jehush, and Eliphelet.
LifeLesson: The mention of Eshek in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
